gap: No Play source, reader or testing response implementation; StoreStatusRequest accepts app-store-connect only.

apiContract.request: PlayTestingRequest(applicationID:versionCode:track:) validates exact identity and builds GET applications/{package}/tracks/{track}/releases. parse(words:options:applicationID:) accepts submit testing-status --provider play --version-code CODE --track TRACK [--directory PROJECT].
apiContract.reader: PlayReleaseStatus.status(request:token:previous:) async throws -> PlayTestingReport. Throws only for credential/identity reflection; operational failures return unresolved reports. Default ephemeral URLSession; offline URLProtocol test injection.
apiContract.binding: Exact request/response URL binds package and track; every summary must repeat exact track; exact integer versionCode in activeArtifacts; multiple matching releases refuse. Display releaseName never used as identity.
apiContract.states: Provider lifecycle draft/not-sent-for-review/in-review/approved-not-published/not-approved/published preserved. Missing, unspecified, unknown, malformed or contradictory matches fail closed. No match is not-observed, never proof upload failed or safe to resubmit.
apiContract.testing: PUBLISHED is published-on-track but testing readiness stays unverified because official state includes halted releases. Upload success is not accepted as a release response. Tester links, actual access and production availability remain unverified.
apiContract.timeout: Timeout/auth/transport/parse failures retain only an exact-identity previous observation as historical; current status unresolved, no testing-ready claim, no automatic resubmission.
apiContract.bounds: 30s request/resource timeout; 256KiB streamed response; <=20 releases per official API; bounded JSON guard; no redirects, cookies, shared cache or credential storage; token excluded from results.
apiContract.uploadResponseLimitation: Missing/null releases fields, including an upload-shaped response, produce not-observed with exit 2 rather than published/ready. Unknown top-level fields are ignored by Decodable; exact explicit malformed-upload classification was optional and not adopted.
apiContract.tokenHandling: Token is used only for the Authorization header; identities overlapping token refuse before network. No token field or arbitrary provider display/error text is emitted or persisted. Finite known state constants are emitted; optional constant-string overlap screening was not adopted.
